'''Etti V''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Etti system/Legends|Etti system]] in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] moved the [[Etti]] [[Species/Legends|species]] off [[Etti IV/Legends|Etti IV]] to the planet and did not allow anyone else access to Etti V.<ref name="EOTECR" />
